title: `patches/@stryker-mutator__vitest-runner@10.0.0.patch` restores mutation
blocker: testing on Vitest 5 (`' > '` join, empty `describe('')` names kept). Blocked on upstream: 10.0.0 is still the latest release. Smallest step: drop it when a release fixing stryker-mutator/stryker-js#6210 ships and `pnpm mutation` still scores 89.98 or more without it.
evidence: Commit 75aab28e moved to @stryker-mutator/vitest-runner 10.1.1, which carries the Vitest 5 fix, and removed the patch: patches/ holds only eslint-plugin-react.patch and pnpm-workspace.yaml patchedDependencies lists nothing else. That commit records mutation at 90.88 against the 89 break threshold. Mutation was not re-run on 2026-11-23.
